messages:
Anna (People Ops): FYI — need quick alignment on a pay-band exception + start date for a Senior Infra hire. Candidate is asking for a +2 band bump and a 4/20 start. Can we get sprint approvals this morning?
Mike (Recruiter): Candidate: Priya K. Skills: distributed systems, CUDA optimizations. Req urgent.
Mike (Recruiter): Offer draft below:
```
Base: $210,000
Band: S3 (band cap $200,000) -> requesting +2 exception
Sign-on: $20,000 (one-time)
Equity: 0.5%
Start: 2026-04-20 (candidate prefers)
```
Sylvie (Eng Manager): +1 from me. This candidate closes a big gap on perf work. I can reallocate part of our contractor budget to cover recurring delta.
Jordan (Finance): Quick Qs: 1) Is the sign-on internal v. external (tax/timing)? 2) Headcount run-rate impact to FY vs next FY? Need both for CFO packet.
Anna (People Ops): Sign-on is external lump sum. FY run-rate hits this FY at full base. I can attach the one-pager justification (link in convo) and the contractor-to-FTE reallocation note.
Sylvie (Eng Manager): I can send the budget reallocation note now.
Carl (CFO): If you can show budget movement (contractor -> FTE) and split sign-on over payout windows (we prefer 50/50 across Q2/Q3 if needed), I'm OK to approve up to $215k total cash comp. Put approval in thread and I'll sign off formally.
Mike (Recruiter): Noted. I'll update offer to base $210k, sign-on $20k split 50/50, total cash $220k but request capped to $215k per CFO note? Clarify and I'll send.
Anna (People Ops): For approvals workflow: please react with :white_check_mark: once you confirm. I'll then route the formal exception to Workday/comp-approvals and lock the start date.
hire-bot: Approval request created: comp-exception/1769005432 — status: pending CFO sign-off.
Jordan (Finance): Reacted :white_check_mark:. I reviewed numbers; can accept if sign-on is split and contractor budget doc is attached.
Sylvie (Eng Manager): Reacted :white_check_mark:. Budget note posted.
Carl (CFO): Approved. Reacted :white_check_mark:. 4/20 start ok. Confirm final comp packaging and I'll sign the approval doc.
Mike (Recruiter): Thanks all — I'll update the offer to: Base $210k, sign-on $10k now + $10k at 6 months, equity 0.5%, start 2026-04-20. Sending offer now and will post candidate acceptance here.
Anna (People Ops): I'll prep onboarding slot and relocation checklist once candidate accepts. Thanks team — please keep thread for record.
